title: Zillow Agent Scraper
description: Scrape real estate agent profiles from Zillow Professionals by URL, agent name, or location.

url.title: Zillow professionals URL
url.description: A Zillow Professionals search URL, for example https://www.zillow.com/professionals/real-estate-agent-reviews/new-york-ny/.

keyword.title: Agent name or keyword
keyword.description: Optional agent name or search keyword. This maps to Zillow's name search.

location.title: Location
location.description: Location to search when no URL is provided, such as New York, NY, Seattle, WA, Florida, or 90210.

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of agent records to save.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of Zillow result pages to request per search.

collect_details.title: Collect profile details
collect_details.description: Open each public Zillow profile to collect extra details such as phone, email, licenses, service areas, and listing counts when available.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy for larger or cloud runs. Residential proxies are required for reliable scraping of Zillow.
